ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant high-intensity white pixels (approx. 60-70% surface area) and low-intensity black/dark-grey mottling (approx. 30-40%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: large, contiguous black patch located mid-ventral, with irregular trailing edge coloration. Right lobe: scattered circular low-intensity spots on a high-intensity white field. Both lobes exhibit high-density black pigmentation along the immediate trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme serration profile with high frequency and amplitude variation; distinct jagged peaks and valleys (5-15 pixel depth) mapped across the continuous visible edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit convex curves tapering toward the tips, with a linear-to-concave sweep toward the central submerged axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, textured white protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized at the distal tips of both left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel dark linear disruptions visible on the mid-to-lower section of the left lobe, characteristic of rake mark morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters on distal tips; vertical linear scarring on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, isolated circular black focal point (spot) in the upper-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
